text:
sylvia: @here quick heads up — at 12:03 UTC we automatically triggered a multi-region ingress fallback for the hosted API due to kube-proxy OOMs in us-west-2 causing connection drops. We saw a ~7% spike in 5xx across EU and US ingress for ~3m while requests were rerouted. Rolling mitigation now, details below and status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1765432100

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created · severity: high · services: ingress-proxy, hosted-api · start: 2026-03-22T12:03:20Z

raj: quick timeline: 12:01 UTC kube-proxy nodes started OOMing during a control-plane upgrade -> 12:03 fallback routing triggered by ingress-controller health probes -> 12:06 started gradual rollout to fallback region (eu-central) -> 12:10 scaled ingress-proxy replicas and removed bad kernel patch on the affected node pool.

mike: mitigation summary: 1) disabled the experimental conntrack optimization that caused mem pressure 2) triggered immediate node drain and replaced 3 nodes in us-west-2 3) increased HPA lower-bound to avoid burst under-provisioning. Latency and 5xx trending back to normal. Will monitor next 60m.

carol: CS note: we pushed a banner to dashboard at 12:12 UTC and queued proactive emails to tenants with sustained error rates >1%. Draft included here for review: "We've detected a short service disruption affecting API requests; traffic has been routed to fallback capacity and most customers are no longer affected. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up if you saw errors after 12:15 UTC." :thumbsup:

raj: runbook checks we executed: ```kubectl -n ingress logs -l app=ingress-proxy --since=15m | grep OOM``` and ```gcloud compute instances list --filter="name~'ingress.*us-west-2'"``` — no remaining OOMs on replacement nodes.

mike: next actions: 1) verify KV-cache integrity for rerouted requests (running consistency job) 2) add temporary autoscaler bump for 2h 3) scheduled postmortem sync at 16:00 UTC.

carol: customer comm will include link to status page and a short FAQ. cc @cs-team for distribution list.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated · monitoring · link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1765432100 · postmortem: scheduled

sylvia: thanks all — please add any callouts to the postmortem doc. If anyone sees regressions ping me directly. :raised_hands:
